output_format: PNG, transparent background, 2048x2048 square canvas, vector-grade edges

brand.name: Cheatjob
brand.category: B2C SaaS, AI-powered job search assistant for French students
brand.personality: Editorial, premium, confident, slightly provocative, magazine-masthead energy, anti-corporate
brand.avoid_personality: tech-bro, hacker-terminal, gamified, cartoon, startup-generic, Silicon Valley pastiche

style_reference_notes: Instrument Serif has a contemporary editorial character with high contrast between thick and thin strokes
Low x-height, elegant ball terminals, sharp serifs
Think of the visual feel of a masthead in a culture magazine like Society or The New Yorker
typography.baseline: consistent, no bouncing letters, no ornamental flourishes beyond what Instrument Serif natively has

background.description: warm off-white, not sterile pure white, slightly cream

wordmark.description: deep burgundy, French editorial red, confident and refined

composition.whitespace: generous padding, at least 25% margin on all sides
composition.baseline: single baseline, no stacked text, no overlapping elements

style_directives: Flat 2D design, no 3D effects, no perspective, no bevels
No drop shadows, no glows, no outlines
No containers, no circles around the wordmark, no rectangular frames
Vector-grade sharpness, as if set in a professional design tool and exported to SVG
Pure typographic execution, the letterforms carry all the weight
Premium editorial feel, as if printed on the cover of a French cultural magazine
negative_prompts: no grunge, no distressed textures, no vintage filters
no icons, no symbols, no mascots, no illustrations
no French flag, no tricolor, no berets, no baguettes, no Eiffel Tower
no clip art, no emoji, no stock graphic elements
no glitch effects, no terminal text, no code aesthetics
no neon, no cyberpunk, no gaming aesthetic
no text other than the exact wordmark specified
no tagline, no subtitle, no descriptor text
no watermarks, no signatures, no artist marks

variations.instruction: Render the wordmark 'cheatjob' in lowercase Instrument Serif Regular at 400 weight. Color: burgundy #6B1F28 on warm off-white #FAF9F6 background. Tight kerning, -1% tracking. Centered, generous margins. This is the primary brand wordmark, the version we will use 80% of the time.

Render the wordmark 'cheatjob' in lowercase Instrument Serif Italic at 400 weight. Color: burgundy #6B1F28 on warm off-white #FAF9F6 background. The italic version is softer, more editorial, used as a brand signature in video endplates and social share cards. Tight kerning, -1% tracking. Centered.

Render the wordmark 'cheatjob.' (with a trailing period) in lowercase Instrument Serif Regular at 400 weight. Color: burgundy #6B1F28 on warm off-white #FAF9F6 background. The period is an integral part of the mark, tightly tracked against the 'b', same size and weight as the rest of the wordmark. The period converts the name into a declarative statement.

Render a horizontal lockup: on the left, a compact monogram 'cj' in lowercase Instrument Serif Regular at 400 weight, slightly larger than the wordmark. To the right of the monogram, separated by a thin vertical rule (1px burgundy #6B1F28, matching the text x-height), the full wordmark 'cheatjob' in lowercase Instrument Serif Regular. All elements in burgundy #6B1F28 on warm off-white #FAF9F6 background. This version is used for app icons (the 'cj' alone) and headers (the full lockup).

quality_checks: All letters must be clearly legible at 40px width (thumbnail size)
No anti-aliasing fringing, no color halos around letterforms
Burgundy must read as burgundy, not as brown or maroon
Background must be visibly warm, not pure #FFFFFF white
Wordmark must look like it was typeset, not hand-drawn or AI-hallucinated
No stray marks, no artifacts, no ghost text, no duplicate letters
deliverables: Four distinct PNG files at 2048x2048, transparent-capable, one per variation
Each file clearly corresponds to one variation id listed above
